result.summary: Several visual layout and truncation issues are present: restaurant names and category chips are cut off, and the bottom of the popular section is clipped by the navigation bar.

issues.description: The third restaurant card under 'Fastest near you' has its name truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards have enough width so restaurant names are fully visible.

issues.description: Category filter chips (e.g. after 'Healthy') are cut off at the right edge with no clear affordance that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add peek of the next chip, a fade/scroll indicator, or ensure the chip row scrolls with visible overflow so users know more categories exist.

issues.description: The lower 'Popular right now' card (pizza with -20% badge) is heavily clipped by the bottom tab bar, hiding most of the image and any title/metadata below it.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/safe-area inset above the tab bar so full cards and their labels remain visible while scrolling.

issues.description: The profile/avatar control in the top-right is a nearly empty light circle with only a tiny red dot, which looks incomplete or broken.
issues.suggestion: Show a proper user avatar, initials, or a clearer icon so the control reads as intentional UI.

issues.description: Delivery fee styling is inconsistent: some use '€0.90 delivery' while the popular card uses a '€0 delivery' pill on the image.
issues.suggestion: Standardize how free vs paid delivery is presented across list and featured cards for a cleaner visual system.
